title: Glass Lullaby Unwound
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: Slow, spacious piano chords in C minor drift through long reverb tails and echoing delays while a sine bass pulses softly underneath. High-register piano melodies gradually layer into the arrangement and a gentle triangle mid-voice adds warmth, with only a distant TR707 rim marking time before everything dissolves back to two chords and silence.
